title: Lock Desk Note: Recent Lock Extension and Relock Costs on a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate
content:
A revised Loan Estimate on a Mortgage Loan File carries a lock extension line drawn from the pricing entries of every Rate Lock Commitment of the customer: extension entries whose cost is borne by the borrower, relock fee entries, and the lock cost waivers Larkspur booked, each with its booking date and dollar amount.

**Rule.** Where borrower-borne lock extension entries were booked on any rate lock of the customer less than 1 whole month before the issue date, their dollar cost, less any lock cost waivers Larkspur booked on the customer's locks in that period and never below zero, is added; where no such extension entry was booked in that period but relock fee entries were, those relock fees, less such waivers and never below zero, are added; where neither was booked in that period, nothing is added.

An entry is booked less than 1 whole month before the issue date where the issue date falls before the same day of the month following its booking date: an entry booked on 10 April is within the period for an issue date up to 9 May and outside it from 10 May.

| Booked on any Rate Lock Commitment of the customer within the period | Line |
|---|---|
| one or more borrower-borne extension entries | the total dollar cost of those extension entries, less the lock cost waivers booked in the period, never below zero |
| no borrower-borne extension entry, one or more relock fee entries | the total of those relock fees, less the lock cost waivers booked in the period, never below zero |
| neither | nothing |

Extension entries borne by Larkspur carry no cost to the borrower and are not borrower-borne entries.

## Cases (hypothetical issue date 20 June)

- A borrower-borne 15-day extension costing 412.50 USD was booked on 5 June, and a relock fee of 300.00 USD on 8 June: the line is 412.50 USD; the relock fee is not added because an extension entry exists in the period.
- No borrower-borne extension entry booked in the period, a relock fee of 300.00 USD booked on 1 June: the line is 300.00 USD.
- A borrower-borne extension costing 412.50 USD booked on 5 June, and a lock cost waiver of 200.00 USD booked by Larkspur on 6 June: the line is 412.50 less 200.00, which is 212.50 USD; with a waiver of 500.00 USD the line would be 0.00 USD, never below zero.
- A borrower-borne extension booked on 19 May: outside the period; with nothing else booked, the line is nothing.
